info.title: AlgoPath Submission Service
info.description:
Submission creation, lookup, evaluation callbacks, and moderation APIs.

Direct service endpoint on its internal port. Public gateway prefix: /api/submissions.

Forbidden.description: Access forbidden; insufficient roles/permissions or invalid internal secret.
